description.text: The world appears, at first glance, to be composed of islands of red suspended in an ocean of gold. Once closer to the ground this is revealed to be countless red-rock mesa jutting upwards from a sandy basin they share. Thin curtains of flowering vines cling precariously to the sides of these cliffs, sticking to the shadowed side of the formations like moss. It appears to have multiple types of ports and bays to accomodate various ships of entirely different design possibly a home to inter-specie alliance, this is also reinforced by the fact that multiple equipment and consoles found inside often comes in various shape and size while seemingly all of the same function. Many of the systems within the station appears to be active with electricity still powering the lights in many area. Thankfully the defense turrets are all broken or inactive so you're free to approach it.

spaceport.text: None of the various ports on the station is compatible with your ship so you landed inside one of the open bay.
